mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND turn_id IN #{turnId} ORDER BY turn_id ASC, seq_no ASC
SELECT * FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} AND seq_no = #{seqNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_working_memory_message (session_id, memory_scope, turn_id, request_id, origin_message_key, run_id, seq_no, role, content, reasoning_content, tool_call_id, tool_calls_json, base64_image, message_kind, visibility, token_estimate) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{memoryScope}, #{turnId}, #{requestId}, #{originMessageKey}, #{runId}, #{seqNo}, #{role}, #{content}, #{reasoningContent}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolCallsJson}, #{base64Image}, #{messageKind}, #{visibility}, #{tokenEstimate})
mapper.sql: m.id, m.session_id, m.turn_id, m.request_id, m.origin_message_key, t.turn_seq, m.seq_no, m.role, m.content, m.message_kind, t.status AS turn_status

FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message m INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn t ON t.id = m.turn_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN session_ledger s ON s.session_id = m.session_id WHERE m.memory_scope = 'main' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.session_id = #{sessionId}

AND LTRIM(COALESCE(m.content, '')) NOT LIKE '[CONTEXT COMPACTION%' AND LTRIM(COALESCE(m.content, '')) NOT LIKE '[CONTEXT SUMMARY]:%' AND LTRIM(COALESCE(m.content, '')) NOT LIKE '[COMPACTION SUMMARY]%' AND LTRIM(COALESCE(m.content, '')) NOT LIKE '[WM_COMPACTION_SUMMARY]%'
mapper.select:
SELECT , MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS search_score
AND MATCH(m.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY search_score DESC, t.create_time DESC, t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
AND (m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR CAST(m.tool_calls_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.turn_seq DESC, m.seq_no DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.session_id AS sessionId, s.title, s.latest_query_text AS latestQueryText, s.latest_summary_text AS latestSummaryText, s.started_at AS startedAt, s.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message wm INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn wt ON wt.id = wm.turn_id AND wt.deleted = 0 WHERE wm.session_id = s.session_id AND wm.memory_scope = 'main' AND wm.deleted = 0) AS messageCount FROM session_ledger s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message wm INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn wt ON wt.id = wm.turn_id AND wt.deleted = 0 WHERE wm.session_id = s.session_id AND wm.memory_scope = 'main' AND wm.deleted = 0) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_active_at, s.create_time) DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.session_id AS sessionId, s.title, s.started_at AS startedAt, s.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt FROM session_ledger s WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_working_memory_message wm INNER JOIN ai_agent_working_memory_turn wt ON wt.id = wm.turn_id AND wt.deleted = 0 WHERE wm.session_id = s.session_id AND wm.memory_scope = 'main' AND wm.deleted = 0) LIMIT 1
